# bash-preexec test fixtures

Unmodified copies of [bash-preexec](https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec) (MIT, see
`LICENSE.md`), used only by the integration tests to check that oops works with the real
thing. `0.6.0/` and `0.7.0/` are the files at the tags `0.6.0` and `0.7.0` of the upstream
repository; nothing from here is shipped in the gem.
